name: Patch Mono Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Tunes for Patch Mono by music style: techno, acid, dubstep, drum & bass, hip-hop, dub, synthwave, ambient, electro, funk & disco, trance and chiptune, plus drum & bass folders for neurofunk, detune stacks, liquid, dancefloor, jump up, jungle and leads that use the patch routes. Bass, lead, pad, pluck and stab sounds per style, plus a folder of patch-route sounds (LFO, sample & hold, envelope and external input routed to pitch, cutoff or pulse width) and a folder of sounds that process the audio input.
